BO-25 / COMPANION STATES • NOT SIMULTANEOUS

○ EMPTY  —  New organization setup. Complete master data, roles, units and integrations before dispatch is enabled.

◷ LOADING  —  Validating dependencies, import references, GPS callbacks and UAT evidence…

! ERROR / VALIDATION  —  Go-live blocked: 2 invalid import rows and GPS failover UAT not signed. Admin permission plus Operations approval required.

✓ SUCCESS  —  Configuration validation passed for completed domains. Go-live remains gated until every blocker is signed off.
